title: White-mod
description: White-mod is a mod for Minecraft that adds a new biome and dimension with a white forest that is actually gray and new achievements.
body:
White Mod is a Minecraft mod that adds a new biome, a new dimension featuring a white (actually gray) forest, and new advancements.

There will be no future updates. Unfortunately, I lost the original MCreator project while trying to update MCreator, so only the three existing versions (1.1.3, 1.1.4, and 1.1.5) remain.

Despite this, the mod adds new content to the game, including a new dimension to explore.

This is a small mod designed to add a bit more variety to Minecraft. If you're interested in exploring a new dimension and trying something different, feel free to download it.
